title: 5.3.15 Reading: Words on a sprite, and sprites that run out
description: A sprite can wear its own words with .text, coloured by .textColor and sized by .textSize; they move with it and stay upright. .life = 60 deletes a sprite about one second later, which is why life was on 5.3.8's list of names not to use. A sprite made on one frame only, such as the frame a hit starts, is fine in draw(). Read before 5.3.16 Worked Example: A "+5" that floats away.
